titre: A queen against a pawn. Can White win? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
White has a queen, Black only a pawn one step from queening. White checks, the king runs to the corner, and taking the pawn is stalemate. Bring the king closer? Black queens. A bishop's pawn on the 7th with the king in the corner is a textbook draw when the enemy king is far. Would you have taken the pawn? 👇
